name: HMR Pharmacy Market Intelligence
description: HMR pharmacy panel sell-out across Portugal: units and value by pharmacy, region, ATC class, product and manufacturer, with generic penetration, SNS reimbursement, stock-outs, unfilled prescriptions and stock alerts. One row per sell-out line, daily from Oct 2024 to Oct 2026.

columns.name: Sell-out Line ID
columns.desc: Unique pharmacy sell-out line.

columns.name: Sale Date
columns.desc: Date the pack was dispensed or sold at the pharmacy.

columns.name: Region
columns.desc: NUTS II region of Portugal.

columns.name: District
columns.desc: District of the pharmacy.

columns.name: Pharmacy
columns.desc: Pharmacy in the HMR panel.

columns.name: Pharmacy ID
columns.desc: HMR panel pharmacy code.

columns.name: Pharmacy Group
columns.desc: Pharmacy network or buying group.

columns.name: Pharmacy Type
columns.desc: Location type of the pharmacy.

columns.name: Therapeutic Area
columns.desc: ATC level 1 therapeutic area or consumer health.

columns.name: ATC Class
columns.desc: ATC level 3 therapeutic class.

columns.name: Product Line
columns.desc: Product line before generic substitution.

columns.name: Product
columns.desc: Brand or generic pack sold.

columns.name: Manufacturer
columns.desc: Marketing authorisation holder of the product.

columns.name: Product Type
columns.desc: Originator brand, generic or OTC brand.

columns.name: Market Segment
columns.desc: Reimbursed Rx, non-reimbursed Rx or consumer health.

columns.name: Reimbursement Tier
columns.desc: SNS reimbursement tier (escalão).

columns.name: Prescriber Specialty
columns.desc: Specialty of the prescribing doctor.

columns.name: Patient Age Band
columns.desc: Age band of the patient.

columns.name: Patient Gender
columns.desc: Gender of the patient.

columns.name: Stock Status
columns.desc: Pharmacy stock status for the pack at the time of the request.

columns.name: Wholesaler
columns.desc: Wholesaler that supplies the pharmacy for this pack.

columns.name: Alert ID
columns.desc: Stock alert raised for an out-of-stock or low-stock request.

columns.name: Alert Date
columns.desc: Date the stock alert was raised.

columns.name: Alert Status
columns.desc: Status of the stock alert: Open, In Review, Resolved, Escalated to Supplier, No Alert.

columns.name: Pack Price
columns.desc: Retail price per pack (PVP) in euros.

columns.name: Units Demanded
columns.desc: Packs requested by patients, filled or not.

columns.name: Units Sold
columns.desc: Packs dispensed or sold.

columns.name: Unfilled Units
columns.desc: Packs requested but not dispensed because of stock issues.

columns.name: Unfilled Prescriptions
columns.desc: Prescription lines not fully dispensed.

columns.name: Sales Value
columns.desc: Sell-out value at retail price, in euros.

columns.name: Lost Sales
columns.desc: Sell-out value lost to stock-outs, in euros.

columns.name: SNS Reimbursement
columns.desc: Value reimbursed by the national health service (SNS).

columns.name: Patient Co-pay
columns.desc: Value paid by the patient.

columns.name: Stock on Hand
columns.desc: Packs on the shelf at the time of the request.

columns.name: Days Open
columns.desc: Days the stock alert has been open.

columns.name: Stock-outs
columns.desc: Requests that hit an out-of-stock pack.

columns.name: Generic Lines
columns.desc: Lines where a generic was sold.

columns.name: Sell-out Lines
columns.desc: Number of sell-out lines.

formulas.name: Generic Share
formulas.desc: Share of units sold that are generics.

formulas.name: Stock-out Rate
formulas.desc: Share of requests that hit an out-of-stock pack.

formulas.name: Fill Rate
formulas.desc: Share of demanded units that were dispensed.

formulas.name: Average Price per Unit
formulas.desc: Sales value per unit sold, in euros.

formulas.name: SNS Share
formulas.desc: Share of sales value reimbursed by the SNS.
